questions.question: What is a partition of a bounded interval $I$?
options: An infinite list of real numbers outside $I$.
Finite subintervals covering $I$ with disjoint interiors
A collection of functions defined on $I$.
questions.explanation: A partition is a finite collection of nonempty bounded subintervals that covers $I$ exactly once pointwise.
questions.source_support: The definition describes a finite set of nonempty bounded intervals $J_i\subseteq I$ covering every point exactly once.
